 Follow Los Angeles Lakers vs Portland Trail Blazers live score, starting lineups, box score stats, standings & play-by-play updates in NBA Cup 2026 on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Juan Carlos Vera López Updated November 6, 2026, 11:24 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 11:24 PM ET 11:24 PM ET 2 minutes ago Halftime: Portland takes a 12-point lead
 The Trail Blazers head into the locker room leading the Los Angeles Lakers 59-47. Portland has controlled the pace for much of the first half, while the Lakers will need to tighten up defensively and find more scoring options after the break.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 Key moments
 11:21 PM ET 1:02: Lillard adds to Portland's lead before… 
 10:49 PM ET Second Quarter Underway in Los Angeles 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 11:21 PM ET 5 minutes ago 1:02: Lillard adds to Portland's lead before halftime: Damian Lillard
 Lillard adds to Portland's lead before halftime: Damian Lillard adds another point from the free-throw line with just over a minute remaining before the break. Portland lead 59-47, holding a 12-point advantage over the Los Angeles Lakers.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 11:14 PM ET 12 minutes ago 2:59: Luka Doncic steps up and knocks down a three-pointer!
 Luka Doncic steps up and knocks down a three-pointer! The Slovenian star cuts the deficit for Los Angeles, bringing the score to 53-43. The Lakers are now ten points behind and looking to get back into the contest before halftime.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 11:07 PM ET 19 minutes ago 5:34: LaRavia adds another point at the free-throw line.
 LaRavia adds another point at the free-throw line. Jake LaRavia makes his second free throw to add another point for the Los Angeles Lakers, who are trying to stay within reach despite the deficit. Portland remain in control, leading 51-36.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 11:02 PM ET 24 minutes ago 6:54: Jake LaRavia commits a personal foul on Chris Youngblood
 Jake LaRavia commits a personal foul on Chris Youngblood, then loses possession as Robert Williams III comes up with the steal. Portland regains the ball and looks to take advantage of the Lakers' mistakes to extend its lead.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:58 PM ET 28 minutes ago 8:20: Damian Lillard knocks down a three-pointer!
 Damian Lillard knocks down a three-pointer! The Portland guard finds room from beyond the arc after a pass from Deni Avdija. The Trail Blazers extend their lead to 43-30, making things even tougher for the Lakers.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:51 PM ET 35 minutes ago 11:26: Ziaire Williams looks to cut the deficit with
 Ziaire Williams looks to cut the deficit with a three-point attempt, but misses the target. On the following play, Deni Avdija gets two trips to the free-throw line and makes both shots to put Portland ahead 31-20, with 11:48 remaining in the second quarter.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:49 PM ET 37 minutes ago Second Quarter Underway in Los Angeles
 The second period is underway at Crypto.com Arena! The Portland Trail Blazers carry a ten-point lead (29-19) over the Los Angeles Lakers. The home side has twelve minutes to tighten up defensively and start cutting into the deficit.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:43 PM ET 43 minutes ago 0:06: Final seconds of the first quarter: Jrue Holiday makes
 Final seconds of the first quarter: Jrue Holiday makes the technical free throw to add another point for Portland, who lead the Los Angeles Lakers 29-19 with just six seconds remaining in the opening quarter.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:37 PM ET an hour ago 1:47: Chris Youngblood knocks down a three-pointer to extend
 Chris Youngblood knocks down a three-pointer to extend the Trail Blazers' lead to 26-15 over the Los Angeles Lakers, with 1:47 remaining in the opening quarter. Portland are finding room from beyond the arc, while the Lakers need to respond before the gap grows any further.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:30 PM ET an hour ago 5:08: Portland respond and begin to build momentum!
 Portland respond and begin to build momentum! Deni Avdija knocks down a three-pointer off an assist from Jrue Holiday, putting the Trail Blazers ahead 16-9 against the Lakers. The visitors are finding their range from beyond the arc and looking to take control of the game.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:29 PM ET an hour ago 6:20: Luka Dončić makes both free throws and adds
 Luka Dončić makes both free throws and adds to the Los Angeles Lakers' score, giving them a 10-7 lead over the Portland Trail Blazers. The Slovenian is already making an impact early on as the Lakers look to control the pace on their home court.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:16 PM ET an hour ago 12:00: The ball is up at Crypto.com Arena!
 The ball is up at Crypto.com Arena! The Lakers and Trail Blazers get the first quarter underway in this Emirates NBA Cup matchup. Los Angeles start with Luka Dončić, Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler, Jake LaRavia and Matisse Thybulle. Portland counter with Damian Lillard, Toumani Camara, Deni Avdija, Scoot Henderson and Donovan Clingan. Let the game begin!
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:09 PM ET an hour ago The wait continues at Crypto.com Arena
 Time keeps ticking and anticipation continues to build at Crypto.com Arena. The Los Angeles Lakers and Portland Trail Blazers are ready to get the game underway, while fans wait for the opening tip in this Emirates NBA Cup matchup. Basketball night in Los Angeles is getting closer.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:01 PM ET an hour ago Waiting for tip-off at Crypto.com Arena
 Excitement is building in Los Angeles as the Lakers and Trail Blazers get ready for this Emirates NBA Cup matchup. Fans are waiting for another battle on the court, with both teams eager to claim the victory. Tip-off is just moments away.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10:00 PM ET an hour ago The Lakers and Trail Blazers get ready for tip-off
 The Los Angeles Lakers and Portland Trail Blazers are making their final preparations before the game gets underway. Both teams are ready on the court as fans await the opening tip at Crypto.com Arena. Emirates NBA Cup action is just moments away in Los Angeles.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 9:54 PM ET 2 hours ago Both teams are warming up at Crypto.com Arena
 The Los Angeles Lakers and Portland Trail Blazers are already on the court going through their warm-ups. Players are fine-tuning their preparations, getting shots up and getting ready for another Emirates NBA Cup matchup. Tip-off in Los Angeles is getting closer.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 9:46 PM ET 2 hours ago The NBA Cup heats up in Los Angeles!
 Crypto.com Arena is getting ready for another exciting matchup between two teams in strong form. The Portland Trail Blazers visit the Los Angeles Lakers in an Emirates NBA Cup group-stage clash. Luka Dončić will be one of the main attractions, while Damian Lillard looks to lead Portland to another victory after the Blazers defeated the Lakers in their previous meeting on October 27. 
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 9:45 PM ET 2 hours ago The ball is about to go up at Crypto.com Arena
 The ball is about to go up at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. Portland enter with a 6-1 record, while the Lakers stand at 7-2. This Emirates NBA Cup group-stage matchup gives both teams an important opportunity to make a strong start in the competition.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 9:41 PM ET 2 hours ago 20 minutes to tipoff at Crypto.com Arena: Lakers and Trail Blazers on the floor
 Final warmups are underway at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles ahead of the 10:00 PM ET (7:00 PM PT) opening tip between the Los Angeles Lakers and Portland Trail Blazers in West Group NBA Cup play (live on Prime Video ).
 Stay tuned right here for official starting lineups and quarter-by-quarter live score updates.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 9:41 PM ET 2 hours ago Crypto Arena
 It is the home of the Lakers - one of the most significant arenas in the NBA - with a capacity for 20,000 spectators. Opened on October 17, 1999, it will host this matchup between the Lakers and Portland. A full house is expected, as it stands out as one of the best games to kick off the weekend; it is, without a doubt, a fantastic arena for a major NBA Cup contest.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 9:41 PM ET 2 hours ago Other NBA games this Friday
 In addition to the matchup between the Lakers and Portland, there will be games featuring the Hawks vs Wizards, Hornets vs Celtics, Cavaliers vs 76ers, Mavericks vs Jazz, Grizzlies vs Thunder, Bucks vs Raptors, Pelicans vs Timberwolves, and finally the Kings vs Spurs; these are the games on the schedule for this Friday in the NBA Cup - there are sure to be some great matchups.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 9:11 PM ET 2 hours ago Keys of match
 For this game, we can expect the Lakers to come out from the very first quarter looking to gain an advantage. They boast a strong roster capable of putting up plenty of points in every game - led by Luka Doncic - so we should see a high-scoring affair where the defenses will need to stay sharp if they want to secure the win. It promises to be a great game, full of intensity and excitement.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 8:32 PM ET 3 hours ago Background
 History favors the Lakers; in their 15 previous encounters, Los Angeles has won 9 times, while Portland has secured 6 victories. Consequently, the home team enters tomorrow’s NBA Cup matchup as the favorite to win - that is the historical context for this major basketball game.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:58 PM ET 3 hours ago How are the Portland Trail Blazers heading into this?
 Meanwhile, Portland is coming off a 132-119 victory over the Suns - an exciting contest in which they ultimately secured an important win. Now, they face the Lakers in the NBA Cup; it will be a challenging road game, but Portland is set to go all-out for the victory. Both teams head into this matchup - taking place at the Crypto.com Arena - promising a game filled with high intensity, plenty of scoring, and lots of excitement.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:25 PM ET 4 hours ago Absences
 Neither team has any injured or suspended players, meaning both will have their top stars available for this NBA matchup at Crypto.com Arena. We will find out tomorrow which players will be sidelined due to coaches' decisions; this is undoubtedly one of the most compelling games on today’s slate in U.S. basketball.

 7:00 PM ET 4 hours ago How are the Los Angeles Lakers coming into this?
 The Los Angeles Lakers are coming off a 116-103 victory over the Kings - a win that should help build their confidence. Now, in the NBA Cup, they will face Portland, aiming for another victory in what promises to be an exciting matchup - one of the best to take place in their home arena in front of their own fans. That is how the Los Angeles Lakers head into this major basketball game.
